plan.title: RFQ vendor bid above budget tolerance

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow used for an RFQ.
Configure the tenant with the required 10% budget tolerance before creating the RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title so the RFQ can be published.
Set the event to an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line item for the budget-controlled quote.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Set the line budget/reference price to 100 for the tolerance check.
Verify that the RFQ line shows the intended budget value.
Invite the vendor named in the case.
Publish the RFQ without placing any bid.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the separate supplier session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ from Vendor A's supplier event list.
